column1: # PlayerStatistics: UserConfig pins every field through its persisted keys, and the save path
# repeats it independently, so the six ints and their getters/setters are exact:
#   The three computed members each clamp min(value*3/(lost*2), 3), i.e. a 0..3 star rating of one
# Unit: aa() returns the field guarded by getGuardPositionOrNull(), and the plain getter name is
#   free -> getGuardPosition. ae()/af()/ak() were tried as hasMoveTarget/getMoveTargetPosition/
#   isEffectActive (their setters are already named), but RenameAst's collision check rejected all
#   three: Unit already carries semantic accessors for the same state, i.e. they are duplicate
#   leftover accessors with no distinct meaning. They stay obfuscated and are listed here with an
#   empty target so the audit shows why.
#   The remaining Unit accessors (Y, Z, ad, ag, ai, B, v, b(float), c/d(UnitList), b(Volley),
#   a(boolean), e/f/g(int), E/F/H/L, the static k(Unit) and the Sortable pair) duplicate an
#   existing semantic accessor of the same state or read a field whose meaning is not yet pinned,
#   so they are left obfuscated (see the notes in run\map-game.tsv).
